titulo.estudio: Suivre les reprises dans un texte : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: Following references in a text: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Identify antecedents, ellipses and links between paragraphs in a cohesive text. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Suivre les reprises dans un texte

frases.estudio: Celles-ci pourront financer des travaux, à condition de maintenir leurs horaires d'ouverture au moins un an.
frases.alumno: These will be able to fund work, provided that they keep their opening hours for at least a year.

frases.estudio: Le dispositif, présenté au paragraphe précédent, vise aussi à préserver l'emploi dans les centres-bourgs.
frases.alumno: The scheme, presented in the previous paragraph, also aims to protect jobs in small urban centres.

piezas.titulo: Key words: following references in a text
Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Identify antecedents, ellipses and links between paragraphs in a cohesive text. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: pronouns and nominalisations pick up earlier ideas; check the referent before attributing an action. In this passage, «dispositif» means «scheme».
